name: @kkulebaev/tsconfig
description: Shared TypeScript config presets for Vue 3 + Vite + vue-tsc projects
author: Konstantin Kulebaev <konstantinkulebaev@gmail.com>

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
